title: The Generous gift from the neighbour
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：generous　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 generous 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the engineer wrote of ① a generous gift from the neighbour in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more generous than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the generous ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most generous gift from the neighbour anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too generous to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the generous ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a generous spirit of the old man, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as generous as the spirit of the old man they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was generous or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something generous, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite generous; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the generous ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, on the same day, she wrote of another generous gift from the neighbour in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more generous than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most generous spirit of the old man in the whole workshop, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the generous ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 慷慨（前置定语 a generous gift from the neighbour：1974 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件慷慨的厚礼）
B. adj. 慷慨／宽厚（比较级 more generous than：文中两处，一处比邻居送的厚礼，一处比预想）
C. adj. 慷慨／宽厚（最高级 the most generous：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 慷慨（表语 too generous to do：母亲觉得它太慷慨，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 宽厚（前置定语 a generous spirit of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩宽厚的心肠）
F. adj. 宽厚（同级比较 as generous as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人宽厚的心肠相比）
G. adj. 宽厚（后置定语 something generous：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 宽厚（受程度副词修饰 quite generous：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a generous gift from the neighbour
the most generous gift from the neighbour anybody
a generous spirit of the old man
The most generous spirit of the old man in

answers.why: generous 意为“慷慨”，1974 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件慷慨的厚礼”，此处作前置定语 a generous gift from the neighbour。
generous 意为“慷慨”，此处用比较级 more generous than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
generous 意为“慷慨”，说明书上 四月 那行字说它是车间里最慷慨的一件，故用最高级 the most generous gift from the neighbour。
generous 意为“慷慨”，母亲认为这件东西“太慷慨了，谁也用不上”，too generous to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
generous 意为“宽厚”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩宽厚的心肠”，此处作前置定语 a generous spirit of the old man。
generous 意为“宽厚”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人宽厚的心肠一样宽厚”，同级比较用 as generous as。
generous 意为“宽厚”，说明书上那半行字要的是“宽厚的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something generous。
generous 意为“宽厚”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当宽厚”，quite 修饰原级 generous。
generous 意为“宽厚”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要宽厚”，故用比较级 more generous than。
generous 意为“宽厚”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个车间里最宽厚的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most generous spirit of the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件慷慨的厚礼。（a generous gift from the neighbour）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更慷慨。（more generous than …）
母亲觉得它太慷慨，谁也用不上。（too generous to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩宽厚的心肠。（a generous spirit of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人宽厚的心肠一样宽厚。（as generous as …）
到了 1981 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件宽厚的东西。（something generous）
answers: In 1974 the engineer wrote of a generous gift from the neighbour in the manual.
Everybody said it was more generous than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too generous to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a generous spirit of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as generous as the spirit of the old man they had once had.
By 1981 the manual asked for nothing but something generous.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 generous 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the engineer wrote of a generous gift from the neighbour in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most generous gift from the neighbour in the workshop, or so the manual says.
My mother thought it too generous to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a generous spirit of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next workshop called the plan quite generous, and everybody laughed.
The generous ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
